messages:
tess: heads-up: tenant nebula-io reports OIDC logins failing and SCIM updates returning 429/403 right after the scheduled alias rotate at 03:10 UTC. seeing decrypt errors in provisioner.

omar: can you paste the snippet?

tess: logs: 
```
2026-03-26T03:11:05Z provisioner ERROR tenant=nebula-io op=POST /scim/Users status=403 msg="decrypt failed: alias=alias/redwood-nebula v=1->v2 mismatch"
2026-03-26T03:11:06Z oidc-proxy WARN tenant=nebula-io auth=callback client_id=nebula-app-legacy err=client_mismatch expected=nebula-app
```

priya: looks like two fold: rewrap/backfill didn't complete for that tenant and a client is still using legacy client_id. the client_mismatch triggers our reject path.

omar: what's the backfill queue status?

tess: backfill workers hit rate-limit and some tenants remained pending. nebula-io in slice B.

priya: workaround: (1) run rewrap for tenant, (2) add a permissive client_id mapping for 48h for nebula-io only, log extensively. low blast radius.

omar: agreed. also add a short-circuit so pending SCIM ops which error with decrypt get re-enqueued automatically after successful rewrap. file ticket INFRA-2299.

kms-bot: Rewrap job queued by tess: tenant-rewrap --tenant nebula-io --force JobID=rw-20260326-07

priya: running now. also pinging support to ask nebula to rotate their SP/Client config if they control it.

tess: rewrap finished JobID=rw-20260326-07 status=ok rewrapped=7

omar: SCIM retries succeeded and OIDC callbacks started returning 200. leaving permissive mapping until 2026-03-28T03:10:00Z.

priya: follow-ups: (a) increase backfill runner concurrency and add exponential backoff + resume on rate limit, (b) add pre-rotate check to block alias rotate if pending SCIM ops > 0 for tenants above threshold, (c) add unit test for client_id legacy mappings.

tess: thanks all, will document in runbook and add audit entry. :white_check_mark:
